reason: The cited evidence confirms that annealing at 580 °C for 24 h introduces L12 precipitates in the fcc lamellae and that precipitate-free channels may aid dislocation storage, but the specific 600 °C/1 h treatment, the >200 MPa strength increase, and the simultaneous ductility improvement are not directly supported by the cited passages.
premises: Al0.7CoCrFeNi can form a lamellar fcc+B2 eutectic microstructure
Annealing at ~580–600 °C introduces nano-scale L12 precipitates in the fcc lamellae
L12 precipitates are coherent and can strengthen the fcc phase
Precipitate-free channels near lamellar boundaries can enhance dislocation storage and ductility
